description: Java class LoginEvents handling user login, password hints, password reset emails, and login validation within the OFBiz framework.

classes.name: LoginEvents
classes.description: Handles user login, password hints, password reset, and login validation events within OFBiz.

methods.name: saveEntryParams
methods.description: Saves USERNAME and PASSWORD parameters into session for later use, handling case normalization based on properties.

methods.name: forgotPassword
methods.description: Handles password recovery requests, calling showPasswordHint or emailPasswordRequest based on parameters.

methods.name: showPasswordHint
methods.description: Retrieves and displays password hint for a given username, or returns error if username is empty or not found.

methods.name: emailPasswordRequest
methods.description: Sends an email with a password reset link to the user, generating a JWT token and configuring email content.

methods.name: storeCheckLogin
methods.description: Checks user login status and store customer role.

methods.name: storeLogin
methods.description: Performs login and checks store customer role upon success.
